## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Jam 'n' Jelly Skool?
No. 26, Lakshmi Nagar, Chromepet, Chennai 600 044 (Near Vaishnava College).

### What facilities does Jam 'n' Jelly Skool have?
Play Group, Pre-KG (2.5–3.5 yrs), LKG (3.5–4.5 yrs), UKG (4.5–5.5 yrs), Day care (1.5–10 yrs, 8.30 am–7.30 pm), Abacus, Phonics, Spoken English, Art & craft, Handwriting, Music, Sloka, Western dance, Bharathanatyam, Karate, Chess, Hindi & Prachar Sabha exams, Tuition 1st–10th std, CCTV cameras.

### What ages do you take?
Pre-KG from 2.5 years through UKG (5.5 years). Day care takes children from 1.5 to 10 years.

### What are the day care timings?
8.30 am to 7.30 pm, Monday to Saturday.

### Do you have after-school classes?
Yes: abacus, phonics, spoken English, art, handwriting, music, sloka, dance, karate, chess, Hindi and tuition from 1st to 10th standard.

### How do I visit Jam 'n' Jelly Skool?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 93842 90888.
